fact: The Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports, and Immigration runs a school-based National ID registration campaign for Primary Eight and Senior Four candidates, launched 4 August 2026 at Juba Day Secondary School.

The Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration with the Central Equatoria State Ministry of General Education launched school-based registration to issue National ID cards on 4 August 2026.
The Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration processed the national identity cards and issues them from its Yei office, with European Union support.
